The statute will most likely be declared unconstitutional because the 7% signature requirement, combined with the short 180-day circulation period, imposes a severe burden on independent candidates' and political bodies' ballot access in violation of First and Fourteenth Amendment rights of association and voting. Under Anderson v. Celebrezze and related ballot-access precedents, such discriminatory requirements that disadvantage candidates outside established parties fail the balancing test.  
CONFIDENCE: 85
